versions.changelog:
Initial release of the food-production-sales-operation skill.

- Provides a streamlined food production and sales operation system, covering quarterly strategic planning, weekly execution, e-commerce KPI management, visual/packaging standards, livestream standardization, and ultimate solutions for high-frequency problems.
- Activates on key phrases related to food production-sales operation, e-commerce management, weekly controls, livestream standards, and KPI management.
- Designed for use across Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.
- Focuses on efficient, result-driven workflows, clear decision standards, and core principles for landing, reporting, and replication.
- Targeted at food e-commerce operations teams seeking a rigorous yet simplified end-to-end operational framework.
